name: Apathy - Midnight Collection ~Vol. 1~
original_name: アパシーミッドナイト・コレクション～Vol.1～
source:
Apathy - Midnight Collection ~Vol. 1~ is an alternate retelling of the horror VN [url=/v745]Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi[/url]. Additional scenarios and art were eventually added to the original in 2007 to make [url=/v746]Apathy - Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi ~Visual Novel Version~[/url], followed by a final version S that added further scenarios the following year.

Apathy - Midnight Collection ~Vol. 1~ is comprised of three stories.

Emi’s Murder Club Observation Diary is the main story of Midnight Collection 1, which chronicles the adventures of a psychopathic schoolgirl and her attempts not to be assassinated by the school’s Murder Club.

The Following Dog is a far more down-to-earth horror story. It revolves around the legend of a dog who will eat you if you look back on your journey.

Scratches on the Pillars rounds the collection off with a very evocative, artistic story. It's extremely short and is completely linear.

[Edited from [url=https://mikanosuke.wordpress.com/2010/06/26/apathy-midnight-collection-vol-1-translation-project/]Guardian's Paradise[/url]]
translation:
《Apathy - Midnight Collection ~Vol. 1~》是恐怖视觉小说[url=/v745]《学校发生过的恐怖故事》[/url]的另一种讲述。2007年，原作加入新剧本与新画面，形成[url=/v746]《Apathy - 学校发生过的恐怖故事~Visual Novel Version~》[/url]，次年又推出增加更多剧本的最终S版。

《Apathy - Midnight Collection ~Vol. 1~》由三个故事组成。

‘惠美的杀人俱乐部观察日记’是本作主篇，记录一名精神异常的女学生为避免被学校杀人俱乐部暗杀而经历的冒险。

‘跟随的狗’是一则更加贴近现实的恐怖故事，围绕一条传说展开：旅途中若回头看，那条狗就会将你吃掉。

‘柱上的抓痕’以一篇极富感染力和艺术性的故事为合集收尾。篇幅极短，全程为单线结构。

[编辑自[url=https://mikanosuke.wordpress.com/2010/06/26/apathy-midnight-collection-vol-1-translation-project/]Guardian's Paradise[/url]]
